test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech:

The researcher said, “We have been examining this data for months.”

options.text: The researcher said they had been examining that data for months.
The researcher said they have been examining this data.
The researcher said they were examining data.
The researcher said we had examined the data.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The researcher said they had been examining that data for months.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **“We have been examining this data for months” becomes “they had been examining that data for months”**
 
 
• Pronoun “we” is changed to “they” to match indirect speech.
 
• Present perfect continuous tense “have been examining” is changed to past perfect continuous tense “had been examining.”
 
• Demonstrative “this” is converted to “that” to reflect indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• Changes reflect proper tense, pronoun, and demonstrative adjustments.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The researcher said they had been examining that data for months.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** “The researcher said they have been examining this data.”
 
 
• Incorrect tense: “have been examining” is not changed to past perfect continuous.
 
• Demonstrative “this” is not converted to “that.”
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** “The researcher said they were examining data.”
 
 
• Incorrect tense: Present perfect continuous is not preserved, and meaning changes to past continuous.
 
• “Data” is not clarified with “that data.”
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** “The researcher said we had examined the data.”
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun: “we” is not changed to “they.”
 
• Incorrect tense: “had examined” changes the meaning to a completed action rather than ongoing examination.
 
 

49:Tddc,

The correct answer is Option 3</stro
